handoff.title: Switch to another agent
handoff.explain: A {from} session can't be moved to another CLI directly. The Hub opens a new chat with the agent you pick, in the same project, and hands over the context: the original request, task list, files changed and the recent conversation. This chat stays as it is.
handoff.note: Next step for the new agent (optional)
handoff.notePlaceholder: e.g. Finish the tests and fix the remaining build error
handoff.foot: The new agent reads the brief and summarises where things stand before continuing
handoff.done: Switched to {agent} — the new chat is open
handoff.noAgents: No other agent is installed on this machine
handoff.buttonTip: Move this chat to another agent (Claude ↔ Antigravity ↔ Codex ↔ Gemini) with a context handoff
handoff.busy: The agent is running — stop it or wait before switching
